summary: This report provides information respecting the 2022 performance appraisal for the Medical Officer of Health.
decided: The Board of Health: 1. Amended Confidential Recommendation 2 from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee by deleting "Confidential Attachment 1 to the report" and replacing it with "Revised Confidential Attachment 1 to the report". 2. Adopted Confidential Recommendations 1 and 2 from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee, as amended by Part 1. 3. Directed that the Confidential Attachment to the letter (June 27, 2023) from the Board of Health - Performance Appraisal of the Medical Officer of Health Committee, Revised Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 13, 2023) from the Medical Officer of Health and Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 13, 2023) from the Medical Officer of Health remain confidential in their entirety, as they relate to personal matters about an identifiable individual, including a municipal or local board employee.
